careerCorroboration.finding: The current official after-graduation page explicitly describes business-process improvement, purchasing/logistics, organizational/technical processes, logistics planning, quality, ICT/project and product-innovation project work, organizational consultancy, and the Innovation Management / Operations Management and Logistics masters. The eight career/outcome interests remain search-only possibilities, with data-driven operational analysis inferred from the current degree emphasis rather than presented as a named guaranteed job. Postgraduate access statements concern TU/e graduates, not this UCR comparison.
